tokens.name: basalt-950
tokens.usage: Basalt page background (color-bg on public pages). Raw palette step — use the color-* roles in components.

tokens.name: basalt-900
tokens.usage: Surfaces on Basalt: footer, form fields, menu (color-surface).

tokens.name: basalt-850
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces on Basalt (color-surface-raised).

tokens.name: basalt-800
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed wells on Basalt (color-well); primary hover on light themes.

tokens.name: basalt-700
tokens.usage: Disabled fills on Basalt (color-disabled-bg).

tokens.name: basalt-600
tokens.usage: Reserved step; not used by any role yet.

tokens.name: basalt-500
tokens.usage: Disabled text on light themes (color-disabled-text, 4.5:1 on basalt-100).

tokens.name: basalt-400
tokens.usage: Muted text on Basalt (color-text-muted, 6.0:1 on basalt-950).

tokens.name: basalt-300
tokens.usage: Secondary text on Basalt (color-text-secondary, 9.4:1 on basalt-950).

tokens.name: basalt-200
tokens.usage: Pressed primary button on Basalt (color-action-bg-pressed).

tokens.name: basalt-100
tokens.usage: Primary text on Basalt (16.2:1 on basalt-950); primary button fill; wells on light themes.

tokens.name: basalt-50
tokens.usage: Mist: the light-chapter and workspace background (color-bg in the mist theme).

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Surfaces in the mist/workspace theme only. Never a public-page background.

tokens.name: lagoon-100
tokens.usage: Rare highlight in imagery grading only — never UI.

tokens.name: lagoon-200
tokens.usage: Accent text on Basalt at 18px and larger (13.0:1 on basalt-950).

tokens.name: lagoon-300
tokens.usage: UI accent on Basalt: focus ring, active tick, progress, live survey line (10.7:1 on basalt-950). Under 5% of any screen.

tokens.name: lagoon-400
tokens.usage: Environment light and charts only.

tokens.name: lagoon-500
tokens.usage: Jade: imagery and film grading, large display accents only.

tokens.name: lagoon-600
tokens.usage: Deep teal: environment shadows; cover and illustration blocks.

tokens.name: lagoon-700
tokens.usage: Accent on light themes for large text and chart marks (5.3:1 on basalt-50).

tokens.name: lagoon-800
tokens.usage: UI accent on light themes: focus ring, links on hover, active marks (7.1:1 on basalt-50, 7.8:1 on white).

tokens.name: dusk-600
tokens.usage: Indigo from the mark: environment light and film only. Never UI.

tokens.name: color-bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Basalt on public pages; Mist on light chapters, legal pages and the workspace.

tokens.name: color-surface
tokens.usage: Footer, form fields, menus, portal panels.

tokens.name: color-surface-raised
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: popovers, the menu overlay's items on hover.

tokens.name: color-well
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed backgrounds, table row hover, skeleton blocks.

tokens.name: color-text
tokens.usage: Primary text on color-bg, color-surface, color-surface-raised and color-well. Basalt 16.2 / 15.3 / 14.3 / 13.0:1; Mist 17.8 / 19.6 / 19.6 / 16.2:1.

tokens.name: color-text-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text (leads, hints, captions) on every surface. Basalt ≥ 7.5:1; Mist ≥ 8.6:1.

tokens.name: color-text-muted
tokens.usage: Muted text (metadata, timestamps) on color-bg, color-surface and color-surface-raised. Basalt 6.0 / 5.7 / 5.3:1 (4.8:1 on color-well); Mist 5.7 / 6.3 / 6.3:1.

tokens.name: color-line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: section dividers, the survey line at rest, row separators. Not for control boundaries.

tokens.name: color-line-strong
tokens.usage: Emphasised dividers and hovered hairlines.

tokens.name: color-line-control
tokens.usage: Boundaries of inputs, checkboxes and secondary buttons — meets 3:1 (Basalt 3.3:1 on basalt-950; Mist 3.9:1 on white).

tokens.name: color-accent
tokens.usage: State only: active tick, selected row, progress, the live survey line. Never a background block, gradient or glow.

tokens.name: color-focus
tokens.usage: The focus outline (2px, 3px offset). Basalt ≥ 8.6:1, Mist ≥ 6.4:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: color-action-bg
tokens.usage: Primary button fill. One primary per screen.

tokens.name: color-action-bg-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button fill on hover.

tokens.name: color-action-bg-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary button fill while pressed (with a 1px press).

tokens.name: color-action-text
tokens.usage: Label and arrow on color-action-bg: Basalt 16.2:1, Mist 17.8:1 (≥ 13:1 on hover and pressed fills).

tokens.name: color-disabled-bg
tokens.usage: Disabled control fill (aria-disabled).

tokens.name: color-disabled-text
tokens.usage: Disabled control label on color-disabled-bg (Basalt 3.9:1, Mist 4.5:1; disabled controls are exempt, kept legible anyway).

tokens.name: color-danger
tokens.usage: Errors: field borders, error text and icons, destructive buttons (portal). Basalt 8.6:1 on basalt-950; Mist 5.9:1 on basalt-50, 6.5:1 on white. Always with an icon or the word Error.

tokens.name: color-success
tokens.usage: Success states and the OPERATIONAL status square. Basalt 12.1:1; Mist 5.9:1 on basalt-50, 6.5:1 on white. Always with a label.

tokens.name: color-warning
tokens.usage: Warnings, DEGRADED status, unpublished CHANGES. Basalt 13.1:1; Mist 6.0:1 on basalt-50, 6.6:1 on white. Always with a label.

tokens.name: color-info
tokens.usage: Informational notices; same values as color-accent.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Archivo at the semi-expanded width, light weights, tight tracking. Sizes are the 1440px maximum of each fluid clamp (see Type scale). One display gesture per shot.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero statements and chapter words: one per station. Fluid 52px (360px wide) to 160px (1440px).

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Page titles on marketing pages. Fluid 44px to 104px.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: H1 on content pages, legal titles, mobile menu items. Fluid 36px to 72px.

groups.name: Headings
groups.note: Archivo at normal width. Weight rises as size falls.

styles.name: heading-m
styles.usage: H3, project titles in tiles. Fluid 22px to 30px.

styles.name: heading-s
styles.usage: H4, row titles, panel titles. Fluid 18px to 20px.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Body copy at 64ch; leads at 52ch. Nothing smaller than 12px anywhere.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: An esports-focused digital experience built around roster presentation, organisation identity, founders, news and competitive gaming culture.
styles.usage: Intro paragraphs under titles. Fluid 18px to 24px.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Why should great organisations settle for average websites?

styles.name: body-s
styles.sample: Tell us what you're planning. Prefer email? Write to us.

groups.name: Instrument
groups.note: DM Mono carries real metadata only: indices, chapter names, years, statuses, references. Labels are uppercase (set with text-transform).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Instrument labels: INDEX — NAME, CATEGORY · YEAR, form section labels, statuses. Always paired with what it describes.

groups.name: Editorial
groups.note: Newsreader Italic, optical size pinned at 48. One word of emphasis per screen, or a pull quote.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: Don't wait for the future. Build it.
styles.usage: Pull quotes (QuoteBlock) and the one italic emphasis word inside a display line. Fluid 26px to 44px.

spacing.note: 4px base. Components use only these steps; a one-off value is a bug.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline offsets, icon nudge distance.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside labels and between an icon and its label (tight).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Label-to-title gap; icon-to-label in buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Control padding; gaps inside rows.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding (m); between fields.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between desktop nav items; between form sections' fields and labels.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a section; primary button height.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between groups of rows; footer column gaps.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Between related sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between sections on laptop.

tokens.name: space-11
tokens.usage: Large chapter gaps (desktop).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Before and after chapter inversions on large screens.

radius.note: Square system: media and sections are sharp; controls get 2px; circles only where the circle is the meaning.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Media, apertures, sections, panels' outer frames on the public site.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, checkboxes, tags, portal panels.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Radio buttons (and avatars, not used today). Nothing else.

shadow.note: No shadows on the public site. One elevation in the portals, for floating layers only.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Portal popovers, menus and toasts only.

tokens.name: shadow-focus-halo
tokens.usage: A 1px basalt halo behind the focus outline when it sits over imagery.

layout.note: Fluid values are the exact CSS used in code.

tokens.name: page-margin
tokens.usage: Outer page margin: 20px at 360px wide to 56px at 1440px.

tokens.name: grid-gap
tokens.usage: Column gap: 16px to 28px.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Standard content width (1408px).

tokens.name: container-wide
tokens.usage: Media-led chapters on large screens (1760px).

tokens.name: container-form
tokens.usage: The enquiry form column.

tokens.name: container-auth
tokens.usage: Sign-in and account forms.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Body text line length.

tokens.name: header-h
tokens.usage: Header height from 1024px (64px from 768px, 60px below).

tokens.name: section-s
tokens.usage: Between related blocks.

tokens.name: section-m
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: section-l
tokens.usage: Around chapter inversions and closing invitations.

tokens.name: station-h
tokens.usage: Home station height (pinned shots).

breakpoint.note: Media queries can't read custom properties; these document the values.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: 8-column grid; Menu + compact CTA header.

tokens.name: bp-laptop
tokens.usage: 12-column grid; full navigation; portal sidebar.

tokens.name: bp-desktop
tokens.usage: Type reaches its maximum; wide media allowed.

duration.note: Portals use micro, fast and base only. Reduced motion zeroes medium, slow and cinematic.

tokens.name: dur-micro
tokens.usage: Checkbox tick, colour and border changes.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, arrow nudge, button feedback.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Underline draw, header hide/reveal, menu close.

tokens.name: dur-medium
tokens.usage: Text line reveals, menu open, page transition in.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Aperture openings, hairline draws, image settle.

tokens.name: dur-cinematic
tokens.usage: The first shot's title settle; time-based chapter inversions.

easing.note: No bounce, no elastic, no spring.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: All entrances and reveals.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Camera-like moves, morphs, crossfades.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Exits only (about 60% of the entrance's duration).
